description:
xargs conformance: GNU findutils 4.10 xargs in the oracle is the reference for status, stdout and
stderr. Commands must exist as programs in the oracle too, so cases use echo, printf, cat, grep, wc,
jq, true and false rather than shell functions.

cases.name: xargs: default command is echo
cases.script: printf 'a b\nc\n' | xargs

cases.name: xargs: max args
cases.script: printf '1 2 3 4 5\n' | xargs -n 2 echo

cases.name: xargs: quotes and backslashes
cases.script: printf "'a b' \"c d\" e\\\\ f\n" | xargs -n1 echo

cases.name: xargs: unmatched quote
cases.script: printf "it's\n" | xargs echo; echo status=$?; printf 'a "b' | xargs echo; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: null delimiter
cases.script: printf 'a b\0\0c\0' | xargs -0 -n1 echo x

cases.name: xargs: custom delimiter keeps empty items
cases.script: printf 'a:b::c' | xargs -d: -n1 echo x

cases.name: xargs: delimiter escapes
cases.script: printf 'a\tb' | xargs -d '\t' -n1 echo; printf 'aAb' | xargs -d '\x41' echo; printf 'a b' | xargs -d '\040' -n1 echo

cases.name: xargs: replace string
cases.script: printf 'one\ntwo\n' | xargs -I{} echo 'item-{}-{}'

cases.name: xargs: replace takes whole lines
cases.script:
printf '  a b  

 c 
' | xargs -I{} echo '[{}]'; printf 'x
' | xargs -i echo {} y

cases.name: xargs: max lines
cases.script:
printf 'a b
c d 
e
f
' | xargs -L 2 echo; printf 'a
b
' | xargs -l echo

cases.name: xargs: empty input
cases.script: printf '' | xargs echo hi; printf '\n\n' | xargs echo x; printf '' | xargs -r echo hi; echo status=$?; printf '' | xargs -I{} echo {}; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: verbose
cases.script: printf 'a b c\n' | xargs -t -n2 echo; printf '' | xargs -t echo

cases.name: xargs: verbose quoting
cases.script: printf 'a b\0it'\''s\0x=y\0\0a\tb\0plain\0' | xargs -0 -t true

cases.name: xargs: eof string
cases.script:
printf 'a b EOF c
' | xargs -E EOF echo; printf 'a b _ c
' | xargs -e_ echo; printf 'a b
' | xargs -E '' echo

cases.name: xargs: arg file
cases.script: printf 'x\ny\n' > /tmp/args; xargs -a /tmp/args echo; xargs --arg-file=/tmp/nope echo; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: max chars
cases.script: printf 'a b c d e' | xargs -s 10 echo; printf 'abcdefghijk' | xargs -s 10 echo; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: exit on size
cases.script: printf 'a b c' | xargs -x -n 3 -s 9 echo; echo status=$?; printf 'a b c' | xargs -n 3 -s 9 echo

cases.name: xargs: failing command gives 123
cases.script:
printf 'x
' > /tmp/x1; printf 'y
' > /tmp/y1; printf '/tmp/x1
/tmp/y1
/tmp/x1
' | xargs -n1 grep -q x; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: status 255 aborts
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
' | xargs -n1 jq -n '"x
" | halt_error(255)'; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: command not found
cases.script: echo a | xargs nosuchcmd; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: directory as command
cases.script: echo a | xargs /tmp; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: option errors
cases.script: xargs -Z; echo $?; xargs --bogus; echo $?; xargs -n; echo $?; xargs -n 0; echo $?; xargs -n 1x; echo $?; xargs -P x; echo $?

cases.name: xargs: delimiter errors
cases.script: xargs -d ab; echo $?; xargs -d '\q'; echo $?; xargs -d ''; echo $?

cases.name: xargs: mutually exclusive options
cases.script:
printf 'a b
' | xargs -L1 -n1 echo; printf 'a b
c
' | xargs -n1 -L1 echo; printf 'a
' | xargs -n1 -I{} echo {}

cases.name: xargs: parallel is accepted
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
' | xargs -P 4 -n1 echo | sort; printf 'a
' | xargs --max-procs=0 echo

cases.name: xargs: long options
cases.script: printf 'a b\n' | xargs --max-args=1 --verbose echo; printf 'a:b' | xargs --delimiter=: --no-run-if-empty echo

cases.name: xargs: double dash and passthrough
cases.script: printf 'a\n' | xargs -- echo x; printf 'a\n' | xargs echo -n; echo

cases.name: xargs: child stdin is empty
cases.script: printf 'a\nb\n' | xargs -I{} cat; echo status=$?

cases.name: xargs: find pipeline
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/x/s && printf 'ab\n' > '/tmp/x/a b' && printf 'c\n' > /tmp/x/s/c && find /tmp/x -type f -print0 | xargs -0 wc -c | sort

cases.name: xargs: endless producer with replace
cases.script: while :; do echo x; done | xargs -I{} echo {} | head -n 2

cases.name: xargs: endless producer default batching
cases.script: while :; do echo x; done | xargs | head -c 10; echo

cases.name: xargs: refuses prompt
cases.script: printf 'a\n' | xargs -p echo; echo status=$?

expected.reason: the oracle cannot prompt without a terminal; bash-tool refuses -p up front
